description:
Bill of Materials (BOM) for SAP Authorization Management Service (AMS) Client Libraries.

        NOTE: This BOM only manages versions for AMS library artifacts. Due to Maven's BOM inheritance behavior,
        dependency versions from AMS module parent POMs may still be visible to consumers. Applications should
        explicitly declare versions for test dependencies (junit, logback, mockito) if they need different versions
        than what the AMS library uses internally.
